items.title: 21.2 Reactivity of Halogenoalkanes (halogenoalkanes kitni aasani se react karte hain) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 21.2 with Table 21.1, printed page 75.

blocks.text: Halogenoalkane molecule (R – X) ke do hisse hain: ek alkyl group, jis mein halogen se jure carbon par partial positive (thora sa positive, δ+) charge hota hai, aur halogen atom, jis par partial negative (thora sa negative, δ−) charge hota hai. Experiments (tajurbon) se pata chala hai ke carbon-halogen bond ki strength (mazbooti) hi reactivity ko tay karne wala main factor hai. Jo bond weak (kamzor) ho woh aasani se toot'ta hai aur molecule zyada reactive hota hai. Table 21.1 mein C – X bonds ki bond energies di gayi hain.

blocks.caption: Table 21.1 Alag alag C-X bonds ki bond energies

blocks.text: Bonds ki strength batati hai ke iodo compounds (jin ka bond sab se weak hai) sab se zyada reactive halogenoalkanes honge, aur fluoro compounds sab se kam reactive. Yani reactivity ka order (tarteeb) yeh hai:

Asal mein C – F bond itna strong hai ke fluoroalkanes ordinary conditions (aam halaat) mein react hi nahi karte. Kuch doosre factors bhi reactivity par asar karte hain, jaise bond polarity, steric hindrance (bare groups ki wajah se rukawat) aur inductive effect waghera.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Bond energy jitni kam, bond torna utna aasan. C – I (228 kJ/mol) sab se aasani se toot'ta hai, is liye R – I sab se tez react karta hai; C – F (467 kJ/mol) sab se mushkil se, is liye R – F sab se slow (sust).

blocks.prompt: Fluoroalkanes par nucleophiles ka asar kam kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: C – F bond sab se strong carbon-halogen bond hai (Table 21.1 mein 467 kJ/mol), is liye ise torna bohat mushkil hai.

items: Reactivity zyada tar C – X bond ki strength se tay hoti hai.
R–I > R–Br > R–Cl > R–F; fluoroalkanes ordinary conditions mein react nahi karte.
